# MyVendor\MyProject

BEAR.Sunday reference application API

## Routes (6)

| HTTP Route | Methods | Resource |
|------------|---------|----------|
| /index | GET | App/Index |
| /admin/index | GET | App/Admin/Index |
| /admin/profile | GET | App/Admin/Profile |
| /cache/admin-dashboard | GET | App/Cache/AdminDashboard |
| /cache/admin-summary | GET, PUT | App/Cache/AdminSummary |
| /user/index | GET | App/User/Index |

## ResourceObjects (6)

### App/Index
`/index`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | name | - |

### App/Admin/Index
`/admin/index`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | - | href(goAdminProfile) |

### App/Admin/Profile
`/admin/profile`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goAdminIndex) |

### App/Cache/AdminDashboard
`/cache/admin-dashboard`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id | src(summary) |

### App/Cache/AdminSummary
`/cache/admin-summary`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id | - |
| PUT | id*, displayName* | - |

### App/User/Index
`/user/index`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | - | - |

## Responses (5)

| Response | Schema | Properties |
|----------|--------|------------|
| Admin_index | admin_index.json | HELLO, defaultAdminId |
| Admin_profile | admin_profile.json | id, username, displayName, active, primaryEmail, verifiedEmailCount, emails, permissions, allowedResources, allowedPermissions |
| Cache_admin_dashboard | cache_admin_dashboard.json | summary, id, dependencyUri, cachePattern |
| Cache_admin_summary | cache_admin_summary.json | id, displayName, revision |
| Write_response | write_response.json | id, message, displayName, revision |
